title: Extensions
summary: Single and double storey extensions designed around how you live, with planning and building warrant support.
intro: Need more room but love where you live? An extension gives you the space you need without the cost and stress of moving.
body:
## From idea to handover

We help you shape the brief, work with designers on drawings, and support you through planning permission and building warrant applications with East Ayrshire Council.

## Popular extension types

- **Kitchen and family rooms**: open-plan spaces with large glazing
- **Single storey rear extensions**: extra living space onto the garden
- **Double storey extensions**: more bedrooms and living space in one build
- **Side and wrap-around extensions**: make the most of awkward plots

We manage the whole build: groundworks, structure, roofing, windows, first and second fix and finishing.
features: One team from start to finish
